subject: the order of latent model simulations appear in inla.posterior.sample$latent

messages.author: 929e733ff7821ad3
messages.subject: the order of latent model simulations appear in inla.posterior.sample$latent
parts:
Hi all,

I have a spatial temporal model where year is separately modeled as AR1 random effect with a time-invariant spde model, so the 
stack is defined something like:
mystack <- inla.stack(
    tag  = "fit",
    data = list(y=myresponse), 
    A    = list(1, 1, A1),
    effect = list (
      X        = myX1, 
      Year     = mydata$Year,
      w        = w1.index        
    )
  )
formula is something like 
y ~ -1 + Intercept. + mycovariates + f(Year, model = "ar1") + f(w, model = myspde) 

Now I would like to simulate samples from the posterior of the fitted model:

sim   <- inla.posterior.sample(n=1000, result=mod)

I am wondering what's the order (or how to identify) of the simulated year random effect and the w in sim[[1]]$latent component, is it related to the order of how then are defined in the formula? I know the first 2 sub-parts correspond to the 1) original samples and 2) the model matrix.

Thanks

Lisa
